items.title: Round Eucalyptus Leaves
items.alt: One airy eucalyptus sprig with several opposite pairs of rounded blue-green juvenile leaves and a tiny new tip, fine muted waxy texture, all leaves and lower stem complete.
items.description: One airy eucalyptus sprig with several opposite pairs of rounded blue-green juvenile leaves and a tiny new tip, fine muted waxy texture, all leaves and lower stem complete.

items.title: Long Eucalyptus Leaves
items.alt: A slender curved twig carries three mature narrow sickle-shaped eucalyptus leaves with long pointed tips, muted green upper surfaces and one pale underside, full stems.
items.description: A slender curved twig carries three mature narrow sickle-shaped eucalyptus leaves with long pointed tips, muted green upper surfaces and one pale underside, full stems.

items.title: Olive Leaf Sprig
items.alt: A compact olive twig with three opposite pairs of narrow gray-green leathery leaves, one leaf turned to show a silvery underside, no fruit or flowers.
items.description: A compact olive twig with three opposite pairs of narrow gray-green leathery leaves, one leaf turned to show a silvery underside, no fruit or flowers.

items.title: Glossy Laurel Leaves
items.alt: One small laurel sprig with three glossy oval pointed dark green leaves, gently wavy smooth margins and a clear central vein, no berries or wreath.
items.description: One small laurel sprig with three glossy oval pointed dark green leaves, gently wavy smooth margins and a clear central vein, no berries or wreath.

items.title: Slender Willow Leaves
items.alt: One thin softly drooping willow twig carries seven narrow lance-shaped green leaves with very fine toothed margins, whole complete gentle curved composition.
items.description: One thin softly drooping willow twig carries seven narrow lance-shaped green leaves with very fine toothed margins, whole complete gentle curved composition.

items.title: Toothed Birch Leaves
items.alt: A short birch twig carries three small triangular pointed leaves with double-serrated edges and delicate branching veins, fresh green, no catkins or tree trunk.
